title: The aa sign, র, ত and আ
body:
# Lesson 2: The aa sign, র, ত and আ

Your first vowel sign: া (aa-kar). It is a straight stroke after the consonant and replaces the built-in o with **aa**. At the start of a word you need the full vowel letter আ instead.

| Script | Sound | Note |
|---|---|---|
| র | ro (r) | র has a dot BELOW; ব (coming next) has no dot. Dot = r. |
| ◌া | aa-kar: aa | Just a vertical bar hanging from the top line; it kills the built-in o. |
| ত | to (t) | Looks like a figure with a curl on top-right; this is the soft dental t, not English t. |
| আ | aa (vowel letter) | It's অ (o) with the aa bar added: অ + া. |

## How they combine

ক + া = কা **ka**. ন + া + ম = নাম **naam**. A sign can't stand alone, so a word that starts with the aa sound uses আ: আর **aar**.

## Read these

Cover the right side, read the script aloud, then check.

- কাল → kal: yesterday / tomorrow
- নাম → naam: name
- রাত → raat: night
- আর → aar: and / more
- আমার → amar: my
- নরম → norom: soft

cards.Notes: র has a dot BELOW; ব (coming next) has no dot. Dot = r.

cards.Meaning: vowel sign aa, written after the consonant
cards.Notes: Just a vertical bar hanging from the top line; it kills the built-in o.

cards.Meaning: consonant soft t (tongue on teeth), with built-in o
cards.Notes: Looks like a figure with a curl on top-right; this is the soft dental t, not English t.

cards.Meaning: independent vowel aa, used at the start of a word
cards.Notes: It's অ (o) with the aa bar added: অ + া.

cards.Example: কাল রাত kal raat: last night
cards.Notes: ক k + া aa + ল l: aa-kar replaces the o, final o silent.

cards.Example: আমার নাম amar naam: my name
কাল রাত kal raat: last night
নাম আর কলম naam aar kolom: name and pen
cards.Notes: আ aa + র r: word-initial aa needs the letter আ.

cards.Example: আমার কলম amar kolom: my pen
cards.Notes: আ a + ম m + া a + র r.

cards.Example: নরম মন norom mon: a soft heart
cards.Notes: ন n + র r + ম m: o after n and r, final o silent.
